result.title: SceneCast: Learning Indoor Scene Synthesis from Curated Synthetic Videos with LLM Reward
result.summary: 3D indoor scene synthesis requires generating objects to form a complete and coherent scene. Existing approaches rely heavily on manually annotated datasets, leading to high costs and limited generalization. We present SceneCast, an annotation-free framework that trains on large-scale, unlabeled videos, addressing two key challenges: (1) Videos provide only partial views of a scene, requiring the model to extrapolate unseen 3D regions, which is inherently error-prone; (2) Raw videos available online are uncurated, suffering from uncontrolled conditions and variable data quality. First, we design a Transformer-based model that predicts objects sequentially and is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), where an LLM acts as a spatial common-sense evaluator. The LLM provides reward signals through chain-of-thought reasoning and code-executable geometric checks to refine object configurations. Second, we introduce \trim, a data curation approach that generates training videos with controllable video generation models. Crucially, it retains only high-quality prefix clips via multi-criteria quality assessment with an entropy-based weighting strategy. Evaluated on curated synthetic video sets, our annotation-free approach outperforms state-of-the-art supervised methods in scene quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SceneCast，一个无需标注数据的 3D 室内场景合成框架：用 Transformer 顺序预测物体，并以 LLM 作为空间常识评判者、通过思维链与可执行几何检查给出 RL 奖励；同时用可控视频生成模型构造训练视频，并按多准则质量评估与熵加权筛选高质量前缀片段。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其「LLM 生成可分步执行的几何检查作为奖励、并按质量筛选部分可见数据」的思路，或可供 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、轨迹贡献分配与部分观测下的状态补全问题作参考。
